topic: Maine, not Florida, is the US state closest to Africa: West Quoddy Head (Lubec, Maine) to El Beddouza, Morocco is about 5,076 km by great circle, while Florida's east coast is more than 6,300 km from the nearest African shore (Western Sahara coast); the reason is great-circle geometry on a sphere.
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: Florida is the closest US state to Africa because it is the furthest south and east on the map.
myths.reality: On a globe the shortest line bends north; Maine's easternmost point is about 5,076 km from Morocco while Florida is more than 6,300 km from any African coast.

landscape.our_gap: Maine-is-closest clips are a single flat map screenshot with text; nobody draws both true great circles on the satellite map, counts both distances, and pushes to each end so the curve is felt.

britannica_gc.title: Great circle
britannica_gc.notes: A great-circle arc is the shortest path between two points on a sphere; on a Mercator map such routes appear to bow toward the poles.
